The main takeaway from our work is that
irreducibility of compositions of polynomials in several variables can be decided by considering only the irreducibility of the factors of the composition.
the irreducibility criteria obtained are explicit, and they can be easily checked in practice.
the number of irreducibility factors of a composition of polynomials is at most the product of the number of irreduci- bility factors of the polynomials involved.
